title: Myth flip — your cycle is a vital sign (Nandini, 37)
caption:
Myth: a period is just a period. ACOG has called the menstrual cycle a vital sign since 2015 — 21–35 days is the normal adult range. Save this for your next appointment.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#womenshealth #cycletracking #periodhealth #hormonehealth #womenshealthmatters

scenes.text: "My cycles are all over the place. That's just *me*."
Nandini is 37, two kids and a 7am standup, and she hasn't known her cycle day in years.
phrases: "How long is your cycle?" the doctor asked.

scenes.text: Two clinicians called it stress, so Nandini stopped bringing her periods up at all.
Doctors count your cycle as a *vital sign*, like blood pressure. In adults, 21–35 days is normal.
